name: Blank IDE Surface
description: An empty IDE model catalogue. Add LLM Surfaces on the canvas.
details: Starts you on the canvas with the Access Point and Catalogue spine only. Drag on an LLM Surface member for each model you want to publish to IDE clients, set a route on the Access Point, then Save.
starter_hint: We've started you with an empty IDE catalogue. Drag on an LLM Surface for each model you want to publish, set a route on the Access Point, then click Save.
